name: SECE
rationale: Synchronous Electric Charge Extraction (SECE) uses an inductor to transfer the piezo's capacitive energy to the storage capacitor at the voltage peaks. It minimizes diode drops by using switches for the high-side charge transfer and only one diode for the output, which should solve the voltage deficit in S2 and S4. A Zener clamp is added to protect against S3 overvoltage.
